title: Build countdown timer component
story: As a user, I want to see a countdown timer during my exercise so that I know how much time I have left.
acceptance_criteria: A Timer component counts down from 10 minutes (600 seconds)
Time is displayed in MM:SS format
Timer starts when the exercise begins and cannot be paused
When the timer reaches zero, an onExpire callback is fired
Unit tests cover initial render, countdown progression, and expiry callback
